datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule for Zambia in 2012. The data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases across geographic units, with multiple scenarios and collection dates spanning January through October 2012. The classifications are standardized using the IPC scale and stored as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML).
